title: Adding an icon requires updating both the SVG asset and the hand-maintained IconName type
answers: What do I need to change to add a new icon to grafana-ui?
body: `IconName` (`packages/grafana-data/src/types/icon.ts:321`, `keyof typeof availableIconsIndex`) is a hand-maintained static object, not generated from the filesystem. Adding an icon means adding the SVG asset AND adding its key to this index; `packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Icon/utils.ts` resolves the file path from the icon name at runtime, so a missing index entry means the icon silently can't be referenced by name even if the file exists.
applies: Only for adding/renaming icons available via the Icon component; unrelated to other asset types.
